case.query: I have two separate questions: My child has been diagnosed with type 1 diabetes. Can you explain why their body is struggling to get energy from sugar? If I am exposed to a high amount of radiation in a short time, what kind of immediate physical injury might happen to my skin?
evidence: With Type 1 diabetes, the pancreas does not make insulin.
Being exposed to a lot of radiation over a short period of time, such as from a radiation emergency , can cause skin burns .
